name: Máriakálnok (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, white, green and white, with serrated green edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Máriakálnok (a white shield with a chapel, waves and a green mound) between the names Gahling above and Máriakálnok below.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
